Sister: You made it through Ice
Path! I only got lost twice.Do not look at me like that. One
of those was on purpose.Shall we compare our teams?

Sister: You earned that one.Give us a little time. Next
time, I will make you workharder for it.

Sister: Fair enough. Ice Path
was enough excitement for oneday.

Sister: We have come a long way
since those puddles in Violet.I think Marill still misses
them.

Sister: Eevee insisted on riding
in my arms through Ice Path.No, I was not carrying it. We
were... negotiating.

Sister: Did I tell you about
Eevee? A Day-Care breeder inGoldenrod let me help with it.It would not let go of my sleeve
when I tried to leave.Now we are training together. It
has very firm opinions.
